mapper.select: select coalesce(max(plan_version),0)+1 from biz_project_kpi_plan where project_id=#{projectId}

select plan.plan_id planId,plan.project_id projectId,plan.plan_version planVersion, plan.cycle_type cycleType,plan.cycle_start cycleStart,plan.cycle_end cycleEnd, plan.bonus_mode bonusMode,plan.currency,plan.status,plan.published_user_name publishedUserName, plan.published_time publishedTime,settlement.settlement_id settlementId, settlement.status settlementStatus,settlement.total_score totalScore, settlement.bonus_amount bonusAmount,settlement.submitted_time submittedTime, settlement.reviewed_time reviewedTime from biz_project_kpi_plan plan left join biz_project_kpi_settlement settlement on settlement.plan_id=plan.plan_id where plan.project_id=#{projectId} order by plan.cycle_end desc,plan.plan_version desc
select plan_id from biz_project_kpi_plan where project_id=#{projectId} order by cycle_end desc,plan_version desc limit 1

select plan_id planId,project_id projectId,plan_version planVersion,cycle_type cycleType, cycle_start cycleStart,cycle_end cycleEnd,bonus_mode bonusMode,currency,status, published_user_id publishedUserId,published_user_name publishedUserName,published_time publishedTime, closed_time closedTime,create_by createBy,create_time createTime,remark from biz_project_kpi_plan where plan_id=#{planId} limit 1

select item_id itemId,plan_id planId,kpi_id kpiId,kpi_code kpiCode,kpi_name kpiName, metric_type metricType,unit,target_value targetValue,minimum_value minimumValue, warning_value warningValue,challenge_value challengeValue,weight,direction, aggregate_type aggregateType,source_type sourceType,sort_order sortOrder from biz_project_kpi_plan_item where plan_id=#{planId} order by sort_order,item_id

select item_id itemId,plan_id planId,kpi_id kpiId,kpi_code kpiCode,kpi_name kpiName, metric_type metricType,unit,target_value targetValue,minimum_value minimumValue, warning_value warningValue,challenge_value challengeValue,weight,direction, aggregate_type aggregateType,source_type sourceType,sort_order sortOrder from biz_project_kpi_plan_item where item_id=#{itemId} limit 1

select tier_id tierId,plan_id planId,tier_name tierName,min_score minScore,max_score maxScore, bonus_amount bonusAmount,sort_order sortOrder from biz_project_bonus_tier where plan_id=#{planId} order by sort_order,tier_id

select settlement_id settlementId,plan_id planId,project_id projectId,period_start periodStart, period_end periodEnd,status,total_score totalScore,bonus_amount bonusAmount,currency, submitted_user_id submittedUserId,submitted_user_name submittedUserName,submitted_time submittedTime, reviewed_user_id reviewedUserId,reviewed_user_name reviewedUserName,reviewed_time reviewedTime, review_comment reviewComment,accounting_fact_id accountingFactId,version, create_by createBy,create_time createTime,update_by updateBy,update_time updateTime from biz_project_kpi_settlement where settlement_id=#{settlementId} limit 1

select settlement_id settlementId,plan_id planId,project_id projectId,period_start periodStart, period_end periodEnd,status,total_score totalScore,bonus_amount bonusAmount,currency, submitted_user_id submittedUserId,submitted_user_name submittedUserName,submitted_time submittedTime, reviewed_user_id reviewedUserId,reviewed_user_name reviewedUserName,reviewed_time reviewedTime, review_comment reviewComment,accounting_fact_id accountingFactId,version, create_by createBy,create_time createTime,update_by updateBy,update_time updateTime from biz_project_kpi_settlement where plan_id=#{planId} limit 1

select result.result_id resultId,result.settlement_id settlementId,result.plan_item_id planItemId, result.actual_value actualValue,result.completion_rate completionRate,result.weighted_score weightedScore, result.result_note resultNote,result.attachment_urls attachmentUrls,result.input_user_id inputUserId, result.input_user_name inputUserName,result.input_time inputTime,item.kpi_code kpiCode,item.kpi_name kpiName, item.unit,item.target_value targetValue,item.weight,item.direction from biz_project_kpi_result result join biz_project_kpi_plan_item item on item.item_id=result.plan_item_id where result.settlement_id=#{settlementId} order by item.sort_order,item.item_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_kpi_result(settlement_id,plan_item_id,actual_value,completion_rate,weighted_score, result_note,attachment_urls,input_user_id,input_user_name,input_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{settlementId},#{planItemId},#{actualValue},#{completionRate},#{weightedScore},#{resultNote}, #{attachmentUrls},#{inputUserId},#{inputUserName},sysdate(),#{inputUserName},sysdate()) on duplicate key update actual_value=values(actual_value),completion_rate=values(completion_rate), weighted_score=values(weighted_score),result_note=values(result_note),attachment_urls=values(attachment_urls), input_user_id=values(input_user_id),input_user_name=values(input_user_name),input_time=sysdate(), update_by=values(update_by),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.update: update biz_project_kpi_settlement set status='SUBMITTED',total_score=#{totalScore},bonus_amount=#{bonusAmount}, submitted_user_id=#{userId},submitted_user_name=#{userName},submitted_time=sysdate(), reviewed_user_id=null,reviewed_user_name=null,reviewed_time=null,review_comment=null, update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where settlement_id=#{settlementId} and status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and version=#{version}

update biz_project_kpi_settlement set status='RETURNED',reviewed_user_id=#{userId}, reviewed_user_name=#{userName},reviewed_time=sysdate(),review_comment=#{comment}, update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where settlement_id=#{settlementId} and status='SUBMITTED' and version=#{version}

update biz_project_kpi_settlement set status='CONFIRMED',total_score=#{totalScore},bonus_amount=#{bonusAmount}, accounting_fact_id=#{accountingFactId},reviewed_user_id=#{userId},reviewed_user_name=#{userName}, reviewed_time=sysdate(),review_comment=#{comment},update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where settlement_id=#{settlementId} and status='SUBMITTED' and version=#{version}
update biz_project_kpi_plan set status='CLOSED',closed_time=sysdate() where plan_id=#{planId} and status='PUBLISHED'
